Malformed terminal bytes must survive through a verified exact-TITO trajectory, while output, agent, and verifier deadlines remain independently visible.
provenance.tightening: These are structural log contracts calibrated against the RNO2A production path; add bounded metrics only when the runner emits them independently of optimizer admission.
